attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 7 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and its whole life is «Ο Όσιος Ιγνάτιος μόναζε σ' ένα κελί κοντά στις Βλαχερνές και απεβίωσε ειρηνικά». The site adds «Βυζαντινός συγγραφέας» under the name, which is its gloss on the name rather than a statement about this man, and no office or writing is drafted from it. No year, so no `dates` object. The corpus keeps many men called Ignatius on other days; this is its own commemoration. No hymn is printed. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (2 October 2026).
